item.title: Search Domain GPOs for the Remote Desktop Policy with PowerShell
item.description:
Overview

When troubleshooting Remote Desktop access issues in an Active Directory environment, one of the most common challenges is identifying which Group Policy Object (GPO) is controlling the setting.

The policy “Allow users to connect remotely by using Remote Desktop Services” determines whether Remote Desktop is permitted on domain machines.

This policy ultimately configures the registry value:

HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\Terminal Services\fDenyTSConnections

In environments with dozens or hundreds of GPOs, manually inspecting each policy in the Group Policy Management Console (GPMC) can be time-consuming.
